title: Apps sent to review
body: We hit the big red button. Taldea was submitted to both Apple App Store review and Google Play review. Now it's the calm-before-the-verdict phase: hoping the reviewers don't trip on the weird parts (ephemeral groups, private links, zero social features) and the build survives the paperwork.

title: Closed Testing hits the Play Store
body: Google's 12-tester hurdle is officially on. The Android build is out in the wild for a small circle of victims: Iñigo, Leyre, Loreto, Jorge, Ekaitz, Jon, Gorka, Carlos, Asier, Luis, Bertol and Andoni. They are the first ones testing if groups actually expire and if the app survives the real world.

title: Taldea dresses up for the App Stores
body: Screens, copy and creatives are ready for the App Store and Google Play. No fake UI shots - just blurred chaos, FOMO quotes and tiny circles trying to explain what's going on.

title: First Taldea build gets written
body: Design stops being theory and turns into code. Groups, moments and the 24h pulse start living in a real app instead of a Figma prototype.

title: Taldea finds its first real design
body: The app gets a proper look in Figma: black screens, yellow dots and a carousel of shapes instead of boring tabs. By Friday, Taldea already feels like a thing.

title: taldea.app becomes real
body: The taldea.app domain is locked in. The idea moves from a random note to a place on the internet where groups might one day panic about disappearing photos.
